items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Clark. That was when Shearing, with Shearing.

ctx.x: Did you ever develop this kind of relationship with any particular drummers?

Bill Clark. That was when Shearing, with Shearing. And after hours, sometimes, even in Detroit that I remember very clearly. We went… he had the phone book in his room, right. May I use your phone book? “Come on, sister. That was [his?] sister,” you know the… I’m kidding, you know, but a black man saying sister, anyway… [laughs]
